confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and tourist-town pricing patterns; no live listings were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderate confidence. July is peak season, so accommodation anchors are less certain and vary widely by booking channel and date. FX is from search results summarizing RBA data (15 Oct 2026); I did not open the RBA page to confirm it, and a third-party report of 0.6947 for 16 Oct is unverified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the Czech Republic's tourist-heavy historic towns (Telc, Kutna Hora) and Prague's outer tourist districts, adjusted for Cesky Krumlov's high summer demand and UNESCO-town premium on restaurants and lodging. Beer and cocktail prices use a local beer-to-cocktail ratio where direct knowledge is weak.
